notes.title: 🎉 The Music Festival DLC is Out Now! 🎶Plus a Mini Words Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/43160692fda946210ccfacf50e404c8ba30638f6.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that the [b]Meow Moments: Music Festival DLC[/b] is now available on Steam! 🐾

🎸 Step into a vibrant open-air celebration where cats and friends gather to enjoy pop, rock, folk, and electronic music. Explore themed stages, cozy camping spots, a dazzling Ferris wheel, and much more — all illustrated by Katia Numakura and set to a chill, festive soundtrack by Tatyana Jacques.

👉 Add it to your game and keep the celebration going!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802160/Meow_Moments_Music_Festival/

[h1]🎮 Mini Words Gets an Update Too![/h1]
That’s not all!
We’ve just released a new update for our word puzzle game, [b]Mini Words[/b] 🎉

🕹️ Now with Gamepad Support – play comfortably with a controller
☁️ Steam Cloud Enabled – keep your progress across devices

If you enjoy relaxed logic word games, it’s a great time to check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158290/Mini_Words__minimalist_puzzle/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/828263e2b7a80914de85a50656214af06ef90ce6.png[/img]

Thank you for supporting our cozy games! We hope you enjoy this new DLC and the updates across our catalog.

notes.title: Update! Gamepad, choose your Pathfinder, languages...
notes.notes:
Hi, we released an update including:

- [b]Gamepad controls[/b] - in addition to the current mouse controls, now you can use a gamepad to navigate the menus and to plan the path in the planning screen. Try it!

- You can [b]choose the Pathfinder[/b] you want to play with.

- [b]New languages[/b] - we included three new languages (German, French, Dutch), in addition to English, Portuguese, Spanish and Italian.

We hope you enjoy them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/22728e390ea48bacff4dddafddf9a296978633fd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/29c974cc827ad4fcc36fe495317c512e85e21873.jpg[/img]

In addition, we'd like to share:

1) Pathfinders: Memories and many of our other games are in the [b]Steam Puzzle Fest[/b], at discount. Take the opportunity to complete your collection! More details at this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2093900/old_view/3730711815891131065]link[/url].
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/5a8324f61a7c5f1c6711e1705a35adda94851029.gif[/img]

2) Pathfinders: Memories is coming to new frontiers - you can play it on [b]Nintendo Switch on 04/May[/b]!

notes.title: Update - play in a different language
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/dae58787d1fe1657114982f08d6e5d2129c67470.jpg[/img]

Hi, we've released an update with a new language selection option. 
Now you can play Pathfinders: Memories in [b]Spanish, Portuguese, Italian[/b], as well as [b]English[/b].

That was made possible with the help of our players' community. Thanks for the support! Special thanks to Lucia Pia Placentino for the Italian translation.

If you want to have another language in the game or even to contribute to translating to another language, post a message in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1294780/discussions/0/5711105714147459955/]Steam community forum[/url], or send an email to contact@menssanainteractive.com 

Have fun!

And take a look at our next release - Pathfinders: Mini Words. 
It's coming to Steam soon! Add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1635620/Pathfinders_Mini_Words/?utm_source=steampage&utm_campaign=patm_page

notes.title: Pathfinders: Memories - Full version released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/f7349379270a52ec7d8c29a72d348bb8442a7fd1.jpg[/img]

Pathfinders: Memories has just been released in Full Version!

Use your memory to help Pathfinders travel through time visiting ancient human civilizations and search for relics. The path to success is full of entrapments, obstacles, and enemies. Memorize them and draw the safe path for our heroes.

The final version adds these features:

- The final civilization - England in Industrial Revolution - is available, completing the total of six civilizations - Ancient Rome, Ancient Egypt, the Vikings, Mali Empire, the Arabs, and Industial England.

- The museum of the human civilizations - the gallery showcasing the relics found in each civilization can be visited at any time. Find all of them to complete the museum!

We thank everyone who supported us during Early Access by playing the game.

We are a small game studio focused on creating games that are simple but provide a pleasant experience to the player, mostly solving puzzles (either logic, word, jigsaw) in a relaxing environment, without timers or rush.

Follow our studio page on Steam to keep up-to-date with our releases!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana
